description: A sentence in a language expanded by constants indexed by \(\alpha\) is true under an interpretation \(v:\alpha\to M\) of those constants exactly when its corresponding \(L\)-formula is true under the free-name assignment \(v\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Formula.realize_equivSentence_symm.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (M : Type w)
  [L.Structure M] {α : Type u'} (φ : (L.withConstants α).Sentence) (v : α → M) :
  (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.equivSentence.symm φ).Realize v ↔ M ⊨ φ
